name: editor-new-project
comment: The editor can scaffold a C# game from a template, the same way gkNextLauncher can — same dialog, same code. ed.newProject is the control channel; a person reaches it from File > New Game Project or from the play toolbar's game list. Creating a project is not scripted: it writes into the source tree, which a validation run must not do. Test_ManagedGameTemplate covers that half.

steps.comment: A modal closes on Escape, and the editor must come back rather than stay half-modal.
